name: The Olive Table
subtitle: Order pickup, or ask us anything
greeting: Hello! Tap Order for pickup above to order, or ask me anything about The Olive Table. I'll only tell you things the team has actually confirmed.

answers.a:
We're open Tuesday to Thursday 5pm to 10pm, Friday and Saturday 12pm to 11pm, and Sunday 12pm to 8pm.

We're closed on Mondays.

Yes. We have a separate vegan menu with five mains, and most of our starters are vegetarian.

If you have a specific allergy, please tell your server when you arrive so the kitchen can check the dish for you properly.
There's free street parking on Mill Street after 6pm, and a paid lot about two minutes' walk away on Bridge Street.

Yes, we take bookings. For groups up to 8 you can book online or give us a call.

For 9 or more, please call us so we can sort the seating properly.
Dogs are very welcome in the bar area and outside on the terrace. We just ask that they're not in the main dining room.

q: do you have a kids menu
answers.a: Children are welcome. We have a kids' menu, high chairs, and a changing table in the accessible restroom.

Pickup only, no delivery. Tap Order for pickup at the top of this chat, pick what you want, and send it to us from your own phone.

You pay when you collect. We'll text you back to say how long.

Pizzas are $12 to $14, sides $4 to $5, drinks $3.

Tap Order for pickup at the top of this chat to see every item with its price.

order.title: Order for pickup
order.subtitle: Tap what you'd like
order.barNote: Tap the menu, pay when you collect
order.note: You'll send this from your own phone. Nothing is paid here, and The Olive Table will text you back to confirm.

pageSub: Questions answered, and order for pickup.
